hints.content:
Start by collecting the significands and exponents.

 $ (\blue{1.5} \times \pink{10^{0}}) \times (\blue{2.0} \times \pink{10^{-5}}) = (\blue{1.5} \times \blue{2.0}) \times (\pink{10^{0}} \times \pink{10^{-5}}) $

Then multiply each term separately. When multiplying exponents with the same base, add the powers together.

 $= \blue{3.0} \times \pink{10^{0 \,+\, -5}}$

 $= \blue{3.0} \times \pink{10^{-5}}$
